After kicking off the public beta season just days ago and rolling out a revised build of macOS 27 developer beta 3, Apple is now pushing out macOS 27 developer beta 4. Here's everything you need to know.

Apple pushes macOS 27 beta 4

Last week, Apple released macOS 27 public beta 1, which carried the same build number as the revised macOS 27 developer beta 3 that launched the same day.

That means, barring any show-stopping bugs, today's developer release will likely come to public testers in the coming days as macOS 27 public beta 2.

macOS 27 developer beta 3 fixed some of the stability issues introduced in macOS developer beta 2 and added new Golden Gate Bridge-themed wallpapers and screensavers. Apple is continuing to prepare for the official release later this year.

The macOS 27 Golden Gate build brings several improvements to Liquid Glass, including a slider that lets users fine-tune the transparency of interface elements. It also unifies corner radii across system windows, apps, and software, addressing a frequent complaint about macOS 26.

On top of that, macOS 27 Golden Gate ships with an all-new Siri AI and companion app, powered by an overhauled underlying indexing system that more accurately surfaces relevant information for Siri to draw on when generating answers. Both Siri AI and the entire macOS 27 Golden Gate release are built on third-generation Apple Foundation Models — you can read more about that here.

macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 4 carries build number 26A5388g. We're diving into the new beta now and will report back with everything we find once we've had a chance to put it through its paces.

macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 4 is now available

Here's how to install the macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 4:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Click the "i" next to Beta Updates
  • Select macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta from the drop-down in the top-right corner
  • Tap Done

What have you found in macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3? Drop us a comment and let us know.
